name: Magic Days
source:
Sarah is a well-known magician. She lives in the forest full of monster with her only cute disciple. But one after another visitors come to her place. After some incidents involving ice rain and summon magic failure she starts to feel something by touching these visitors...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
莎拉是一位著名的魔法师，与自己唯一的可爱弟子生活在一座怪物遍布的森林里。然而，访客们接二连三地找上门。在经历了与冰雨有关的风波，以及召唤魔法失败等事件后，她在与这些访客接触的过程中，渐渐产生了某种感情…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
